analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($139.14) vs SMA5/20/50 ($146.08/$149.87/$149.38): trading below short/mid-term averages, indicating weak positioning.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($146.49/$133.41): mixed long-term trend, above SMA200.
· 52-week position (72.3%) + current price level is 12.5% below 52-week high.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (45.8→36.9): entering oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.8559→-1.0603): continued worsening, maintaining bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $140.44): approaching lower band, with 12.58% band width suggesting potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($137.52): based on 20-day low, next support level if price declines.
· Swing resistance ($145.93): based on 5-day high, potential for short-term bounce if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (potential Lower Low): suggesting continuation of downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.06x): normal level, indicating moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): conditions for maintaining a wait-and-see approach due to RSI entering oversold and ADX showing no trend.
